senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פַּלְפִּל II, a. פּוּלְסָא)to roll in, cover with.
to roll one’s self, cover one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 58a:16">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>קרעתו ונִתְפַּלְּשָׁח באפר</he> (not <he>קרעתה</he>) she rent it (the shirt) and rolled herself in the dust; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 276">Yalk. Jer. 276</cite>.
